thread.title: Dow's 200-point slide, driven by Microsoft, Apple's stocks as tech sector falls

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow's 200-point slide, driven by Microsoft, Apple's stocks as tech sector falls
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was off more than 200 points in late-Tuesady afternoon trade, as shares of Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -4.59% and Apple Inc. AAPL, -2.84% among the leaders of Monday's surge, came under heavy selling pressure. Along with shares of Goldman Sachs Group Inc. GS, -2.94% those Dow components were exacting a roughly 80-point toll on the price-weighted blue-chip average. The technology sector was being buffeted the most, with the exchange-traded Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF XLK, -3.36% trading down 2.2% on the day. The technology-laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -3.01% was off 2.1%. Most recently, the Dow was down about 200 points, or 0.8%, at 23,998, while the S&P 500 index SPX, -1.88% was 1.1% lower at 2,628.
